description: S459 MED-2: a server-authority cell whose SSR hydration seed its refinement refuses (`R[]` with `n: number(>0)`, a seeded row with n = -5). The seed is judged like any write; the refused value is NOT applied, the cell keeps its initial value, the refusal is reported to the logging surface, and seeding (@names, after it) and boot (the click handler) continue. Before the fix the refusal threw out of top-level client code: later cells were never seeded and no handler was wired.
rationale: §53.3.3: a refused value is not applied — the variable retains its prior value. §52.8 note (S459): a refused seed is treated like a persist= restore (§6.14.2 rule 3, take the default on refusal, never coerced), not a boot-time throw.
